description:
Asher's Hammer

The Luddic Church fights for souls, not territory, and its large but ramshackle fleets reflect this. Sometimes, however, some among the penitent Faithful on Asher are able to bring ships into service which reflect the Church's specific needs.

Version 2.0 (stable). A mini-mod adding five ships to the Luddic Church's blueprint and fleet roster: all sprites are standard saving a new paint job, featuring

calming pistachio green

.

Peregrinatio, a Starliner derivative built for efficiency rather than luxury.Refugium, a fleet-tender built on the Colossus chassis.Prelate, a Hermes update that is considerably more survivable and could be turned into a smuggling vessel.Malleus, or what happens when you take a Valkyrie, put two missile hardpoints up front, and strip out all that troop stuff for a missile autoloader and expanded missile racks.Fidelium, an outdated escort carrier built on the Tarsus.

Spoiler
Changelog/New Ships
Administrative: Updated Ship Roles file for these craft. Added "container" folder to hold the file data for download.

Nettle: Peregrinatio with awkwardly planted teeth but no cargo capacity to speak of.


Narthex: Condor-style conversion, hull (largely) intact, so don't expect armor.


Pather-style vessels:

Repurposed MkII, dedicated Pilum-thrower


Chisel and Hephaestos: the Pathers fold the hull in on itself to add armor without increasing weight. 
This takes that idea to its logical conclusions. Yes, that's an Orion drive on the Chisel.

Capital:

The Church is in no condition to turn down scavenged vessels, so when an Atlas MkII falls into their hands, it gets turned into an ersatz carrier.

Download here:

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OJzieAkWJ5R2YDrqN2a_rf0ymxsUhLLP?usp=sharing
descriptionHtml:
Asher's Hammer

The Luddic Church fights for souls, not territory, and its large but ramshackle fleets reflect this. Sometimes, however, some among the penitent Faithful on Asher are able to bring ships into service which reflect the Church's specific needs.

Version 2.0 (stable). A mini-mod adding five ships to the Luddic Church's blueprint and fleet roster: all sprites are standard saving a new paint job, featuring calming pistachio green.

  1. Peregrinatio, a Starliner derivative built for efficiency rather than luxury.
  2. Refugium, a fleet-tender built on the Colossus chassis.
  3. Prelate, a Hermes update that is considerably more survivable and could be turned into a smuggling vessel.
  4. Malleus, or what happens when you take a Valkyrie, put two missile hardpoints up front, and strip out all that troop stuff for a missile autoloader and expanded missile racks.
  5. Fidelium, an outdated escort carrier built on the Tarsus.

SpoilerChangelog/New Ships

Chisel and Hephaestos: the Pathers fold the hull in on itself to add armor without increasing weight.
This takes that idea to its logical conclusions. Yes, that's an Orion drive on the Chisel.
